stem: Three unlabeled cups contain source water, feed solution and runoff. What should the technician do?
choices: Measure all three and guess their identities from the EC values
Discard/recollect or resolve identity using the approved procedure rather than guessing
Label the lowest EC as source water automatically
Combine the samples so only one reading is needed
rationale: Sample identity is part of measurement integrity. Guessing from the result can turn a correct meter reading into an incorrect record and decision.
